title: Single shared SQLite connection under a global lock serializes all requests
evidence: app.py:56-57 one connection guarded by self._lock; every CRUD method acquires it, so ThreadingHTTPServer concurrency is effectively serialized at the store
suggestion: Use a connection-per-thread pool or SQLite WAL if concurrent throughput matters; fine for the task's scope
